title: Push shonei-server
text: shonei-server is deployed (12d58a0, 662ed86, c960adc) but not pushed to GitHub. Push it? I would.

title: Track hover top row
text: T-3714: the hover over track or a line now starts with a row like Regular, the count icon, Quad (rebuilt from look B, since look C never changed the hover). Is that the hover you liked? Screenshot artifacts/trainworld/review/t3714-hover-tag.png.

title: Word in the placing tag
text: T-3714: the placing tag shows the 1, 2 or 4 track icon alone, in the type's colour, left of the level. Add the word too (Quad)? I'd leave the icon alone.

title: Comments A/B test
text: T-3726: replay 2-3 of today's tasks from their parent commits, one tree with comments and one stripped by script, same blind brief, scored on the real fix's tests first, then wrong causes, tokens and time; one task twice per arm for noise. About 8-10 runs at 100-250k tokens. Run it after the release?

title: Points by cost recovery in v0.4.2
text: T-3657 is built: each line's points scale with min(1, fares / running cost). Honest networks lose a median 0.13% (worst 1.65%); free-fare networks drop to 0. A checker is running. Include it in v0.4.2 if it passes? Board scores change only when each game sends a new result, so unopened games keep old figures. One shared NYC network with base fare 0 and a high per-km fare loses 26.6%: fine?
